name: Rocket Nozzles and Thrust Vector Control
summary: Design of rocket nozzles for real flight conditions and the methods used to steer a rocket's thrust.

topics.name: Nozzle losses: divergence, boundary layer, two-phase flow and kinetics
Method of characteristics for nozzle design
Over-expanded flow, flow separation and side loads
Altitude compensation: aerospikes, expansion-deflection and extendible nozzles
Nozzle cooling and materials: regenerative, radiative, ablative
Thrust vector control: gimballed engines and flexible nozzle joints
Jet vanes, jet tabs and secondary injection
Rocket exhaust plumes: structure, radiation, and base heating
